sentences.15.1 «Du må finne den hemmelige døra.»: 15.1 "You have to find the secret door."
A conversation with Karim (36) from Syria.
sentences.Karim har bodd på Hero flyktningmottak i: Karim has lived at Hero refugee reception centre in Ålesund for a year.
sentences.Mottaket skal snart stenge, og Karim og: The reception centre is closing soon, and Karim and the others who live there have to move.
sentences.Har du blitt kjent med mange nordmenn he: Have you got to know many Norwegians here?
sentences.Ja, jeg har blitt kjent med veldig mange: Yes, I've got to know a great many people from different backgrounds.
sentences.Jeg har blitt kjent med folk på gata, på: I've got to know people in the street, in the shop and at training.
sentences.Jeg har møtt nye folk i frivillige organ: I've met new people in voluntary organisations such as Refugees welcome to Sunnmøre, Norwegian People's Aid, the Red Cross and International Café.
sentences.Nordmenn er opptatt av tid. De er også v: Norwegians care a lot about time. They are also very calm and respect each other's privacy.
sentences.Nordmenn stiller ikke private spørsmål o: Norwegians don't ask personal questions about your life.
sentences.Jeg liker å tenke på nordmenn som en veg: I like to think of Norwegians as a wall.
You have to get past the wall.
You have to find the secret door.
sentences.Du trenger bare å banke på, og du vil fi: You only need to knock, and you will find the magic door.
sentences.Du har blitt kjent med nordmenn her i Ål: You have got to know Norwegians here in Ålesund.
sentences.Hva bør innvandrere gjøre for å bli kjen: What should immigrants do to get to know Norwegians?
sentences.Du bør smile mye og snakke med folk, for: You should smile a lot and talk to people, because that is the key to people's hearts.
sentences.Det er også viktig å bruke det du kan fr: It is also important to use what you already know and to offer help.
sentences.Jeg synes at du ikke må prøve å bli en a: I think you mustn't try to be someone other than who you are.
You must be yourself and respect others.
sentences.Det er lurt å delta på arrangementer der: It is a good idea to take part in events where you live.
sentences.Jeg har brukt erfaringen min fra hjemlan: I have used my experience from my home country a lot.
sentences.Der jobbet jeg med store arrangementer,: There I worked with big events, and here I have helped out at many events in the town, such as the Jugend Festival, Ålesund Live, the Boat Festival and many other activities.
I have done lots of different things.
sentences.Jeg har vært tolk på mottaket, på sykehu: I have been an interpreter at the reception centre, at the hospital and at the police station.
sentences.Jeg har arrangert kvelder med norsk og u: I have organised evenings with Norwegian and foreign folk dancing, and I have cooked at several events.
sentences.Jeg har også hjulpet folk på dugnad med: I have also helped people at dugnads with building foundations for houses and with rounding up sheep.
sentences.Jeg har vært frivillig lærer og undervis: I have been a volunteer teacher and taught Norwegians Arabic language and culture, so that they will understand us better.
You have now lived in Norway for a year.
sentences.Har du begynt å gjøre noe som er typisk: Have you started doing anything typically Norwegian?
Yes, I have learned a lot of new things.
sentences.Jeg liker at mange nordmenn har et nært: I like that many Norwegians have a close relationship with nature.
Norwegians usually go for a walk every day.
sentences.I hjemlandet mitt kjørte vi alltid bil,: In my home country we always drove, even when it only took three minutes.
sentences.Her har jeg lært at det er bra å gå, og: Here I have learned that walking is good, and I walk for 45 minutes every day now.
sentences.Kommer du til å savne Ålesund?: Are you going to miss Ålesund?
sentences.Ja, jeg vil savne havet, fjellene, gaten: Yes, I will miss the sea, the mountains, the streets and the people I meet here every morning.
sentences.Jeg vil savne lufta her, en blanding av: I will miss the air here, a mixture of the salt from the sea and the smell of the trees.
sentences.Jeg vil savne lyden fra båtene som komme: I will miss the sound of the boats coming and going.
sentences.Tror du at du vil holde kontakten med Ål: Do you think you will keep in touch with Ålesund and the people here?
sentences.Vi har et ordspråk på arabisk som sier «: We have a saying in Arabic that goes "Two mountains cannot meet, but people can meet".
sentences.Mange steder i Norge arrangerer frivilli: In many places in Norway voluntary organisations run an international café.
sentences.Der kan nordmenn og innvandrere møte hve: There Norwegians and immigrants can meet each other.
